mechanism: Dexamethasone induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing fluphenazine metabolism and reducing its antipsychotic efficacy; concurrent use also increases risk of anticholinergic effects and CNS depression.
action: Monitor psychiatric symptoms closely and consider fluphenazine dose adjustment upward; assess for reduced antipsychotic effect and anticholinergic adverse effects during corticosteroid therapy.
